items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: except the Bill Eckstine band was close to it.

ctx.x: Lot of people don't--is not hip to the Cootie Williams big band. Especially younger--the last three or four generations. But in my time, when I was coming up, and I don't think I have heard anything like that yet, except the Bill Eckstine band was close to it. You ever heard the Cootie Williams big band?
I heard some recordings of that. Was this done with--was Bud playing with them?
